title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - StorageConfiguration
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/StorageConfiguration. Represents the attributes that are configurable at service instantiation for storage service offerings. Subclass of InstantiationRequirement per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InstantiationRequirement model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'StorageConfiguration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

storageCompression.description: Property. Available compression features. Controlled-vocabulary value (CompressionAlgorithm), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

storageDeduplication.description: Property. Deduplication features available for the storage service (e.g. inline or post-processing). Controlled-vocabulary value (DeduplicationMethod), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

storageEncryption.description: Relationship. Available encryption features. Links to one or more Encryption entities.

storageRedundancyMechanism.description: Property. Underlying data protection mechanism (e.g. RAID levels or Erasure Codes). Controlled-vocabulary value (StorageRedundancyMechanism), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

storageProtection.description: Relationship. Available data protection features. Links to one or more DataProtectionPolicy entities.

storageQoS.description: Relationship. Available QoS class for the storage service. Links to one or more QoS entities.

blockSize.description: Relationship. Available block size(s) to be used. Links to one or more MemorySize entities.
